data.standardized_narrative: In 2017, Syndicate 1084 reported a release of GBP 39.4 million in technical reserves related to prior periods. This favourable development primarily stemmed from the Energy and Marine Divisions. The report also noted significant catastrophe events in 2017, including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, Mexican earthquakes, and California wildfires, with estimated ultimate net claims of GBP 99.3 million. Prior year events from 2016, such as the Fort McMurray wildfire and the New Zealand earthquake, had estimated ultimate net claims of GBP 6.3 million and GBP 6.6 million respectively.

data.data_quality_notes: The explicit statement of a GBP 39.4m release in Note 4 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' has been used as per instructions. This figure, however, differs from a calculation of prior year gross claims incurred development derived from the gross claims development triangle in Note 20, which suggests a strengthening of GBP 89.0m. The discrepancy may arise from differences in what 'technical reserves' (Note 4) versus 'claims incurred' (Note 20 triangle) specifically encompass, or the scope of 'prior periods'.
